name: codeflow-viewer
//type: Deliberately absent. It would silence node's reparse warning for the .ts tests, and it also flips esbuild to node-ESM interop: every `__toESM(cjs())` becomes `__toESM(cjs(), 1)`, which overwrites a module's own `default` with the whole module.exports. That is what broke cytoscape-elk, and setting it today still changes the bundle - elkjs and react-dom/client both take the flag. Neither is harmed by it, because one exports `default = itself` and the other declares no `default` at all, so the page is currently safe by luck of two dependencies rather than by anything we control. The failure it invites is a wrong `default` on a page no unit test loads. A warning is cheaper than that.
description: Tooling for the interactive viewer: vendored browser libraries and the JS tests. The Kotlin build does not depend on any of this.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:bundle && node --test app/src/test/js/unit/*.test.ts
